name: nhi-scoper
description: Short-lived credential gate. Fetches a token from a configured broker only; it never invents a token and never falls back to a long-lived credential.

brokerUrl.title: Token broker URL
brokerUrl.description: https URL (or localhost) that returns JSON like {"token":"...","expiresInMs":900000} for /nhi-refresh. Leave empty until a broker is set up.
